task.description: Re-check rework 2 of ISS-0437's design: the state.refs uniform-shape fix for :global admissions, and the alias-note correction.

result.note: Global-shape fix confirmed present: handle_call({:try_acquire, :global}) now stores {:global, nil} instead of the bare atom, closing the mixed-shape gap; section 8 lists this clause as changed. End-to-end shape consistency verified: state.refs type, both try_acquire clauses, and release_tenant/3's revised 3-arg spec (captured_generation ignored for :global, compared for {:tenant, schema}) are all mutually consistent and match real admission.ex:271-345 as the diff target. Original FAIL #1 race re-traced independently a third time, still lands in_use=1, not regressed by the :global-clause edit. Alias note verified accurate against real routers/tenants.ex:160 (Letflow.TenantProvisioning already aliased there, Letflow.Admission absent, matching the doc's claim). No new defect found on this third pass (checked ensure_tenant_tracked/2 signature stability, release handle_call's Map.pop destructure implied by the new 2-tuple shape, no mixed-shape entry path remains). No disguised implementation code (grep clean, arrows/do/end are prose, self-flagged as such in-doc). No TBD/deferral language. Design is unambiguous and complete enough to hand to ELIXIR-DEV as-is.
